text:
Nina: Quick heads-up — CloudMall changed the marketplace SKU for our joint marketplace listing and our reservation `cm-resv-309` in eu-west-2 no longer binds. We need 14x A40-class GPUs for the SI proof-of-concept next Wed 08:00 UTC (48h). Any procurement/ops suggestions?

market-bot: SYNC_FAILURE: UNMAPPED_SKU for cm-resv-309
```
reservation: cm-resv-309
old_sku: CM-A40-v1
new_sku: CM-A40-Gen2
error: ALIAS_NOT_FOUND
```

Derek: Vendor notes: SKU rename due to binning changes, lead-time moved 5d -> 13d. We have 6 in Dedicated eu-west-2, 4 in partner racks (need delegation), and 6 incoming transit ETA 9d. Immediate gap = 8 nodes.

Sophia: Options: (1) reallocate 8 from internal dev (CI impact), (2) buy short-term partner-hosted instances for the window (+premium), (3) accept cross-region fallback to eu-north (latency +15ms). What's the customer's tolerance?

Nina: SI leadership insists on full 14 for the demo; they want to avoid degraded performance. Marketing also booked live session. We need a decision in 45m.

finance-bot: Emergency partner hold quote received: +30% fee, non-refundable. Legal needs SOW sign-off.

Derek: Quick pragmatic plan: Map new SKU CM-A40-Gen2 -> internal alias `cm-a40-gen2-2026` and create composite reservation across Dedicated + partner pool. Ops can patch mapper and create the composite canary in ~90m. Meanwhile finance/legal can fast-track SOW for partner hold as fallback.

oncall-eng: I'll patch the mapper to accept the new alias and spin a canary. ETA 1h. Also can do a temporary route split if we must combine Dedicated + partner-hosted pools for the demo window.

Sophia: Okay — action items:
- Derek: confirm mapping request and start partner delegation process
- oncall-eng: patch mapper + create canary (watch CPU/mem and latency)
- finance-bot: prep SOW quote for emergency hold if mapping fails
- Nina: tell SI we'll confirm within 60m

market-bot: Alias mapping submitted: CM-A40-Gen2 -> cm-a40-gen2-2026. Re-run scheduled.

Derek: Partner delegation in flight; vendor says they can hold 4 nodes for 72h with PO.

market-bot: Reservation cm-resv-309 resolved -> cm-a40-gen2-2026. Composite reservation active across Dedicated + partner pool for Wed 08:00 -> Fri 08:00 UTC.

Nina: Perfect. Notify SI and copy marketing. If mapping flips again we trigger partner hold and sign SOW. Thanks team :thumbsup:
